prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: pixel sprite animation sheet for an offline tactical RPG review.
Input 1: existing Golden Knight idle contact sheet. Top row is the original game motion reference, bottom row is current art to correct. Input 2: existing standing knight (identity reference). Input 3: accepted protagonist (style and palette-simplicity reference).
Create ONE sprite sheet with three equally sized square cells in a single horizontal row on a genuinely transparent background, NO labels, NO grid, NO text. Each cell is a 96x96 logical pixel sprite, enlarged crisply as necessary. Same left-facing white-gray horse, same mounted gold knight, same diagonal spear and silhouette as input 2; maintain recognisable mounted knight, 4 legs, spear, saddle, armor.
Three cells left to right: BOTH FRONT LEGS raised bent forward with BOTH HIND LEGS planted; ALL FOUR LEGS standing; BOTH HIND LEGS raised bent with BOTH FRONT LEGS planted.
The rider, spear, horse head, neck, trunk, saddle, tail root, shoulder and hip positions must remain EXACTLY fixed in all three cells. Only the relevant pair of legs below their joints changes; no whole-body translation, no bobbing, no leaning or rocking. Front legs means image LEFT pair at horse chest; hind legs means image RIGHT pair at rump. Separate near/far limbs with restrained dark gray and muted cream so both legs are readable.
Palette simplify aggressively to 7 or 8 flat colors total plus transparency: charcoal outline, soft cool gray shadow, warm gray-white horse and armor highlight, muted antique gold, darker desaturated ochre, a small neutral skin tone, dark gray reins/saddle. Gray-white and pale antique gold dominate. Remove vivid orange, neon yellow, bright cyan, blue saddle cloth, glitter and numerous specular colors. Large clean pixel clusters, no airbrushing, no texture, no dithering, no gradients, no anti-aliasing; match input 3's compact readable sprite style. Keep spear fully visible and no part clipped. No cast shadow; shadow belongs to a separate fixed ground layer.

Edit this exact 3-cell sprite sheet. Preserve all cell sizes, registration, character size, pose orientation, horse body, rider and spear positions.
Critical correction in RIGHTMOST CELL ONLY: BOTH horse hind legs on image-right must be raised together, bent forward under the rump. NEITHER hind hoof touches the ground. Show two separate raised bent hind limbs side by side with a small offset for readability. Both forelegs on image-left remain planted. The hind legs correspond to the horse legs at the rightmost rump, not the rider leg in the center. Keep the existing leftmost cell's BOTH forelegs raised and center cell's four-leg stand.
Second correction across ALL THREE CELLS: convert to a much more muted and simpler palette, with gray white dominant, pale desaturated antique gold armor accents. NO glossy bright yellow/orange; no blue. No tiny sparkling highlights. Flat pixel clusters with 8 colors max: charcoal outline #24303b, dark gray #50545a, muted gray #858985, light warm gray #c6c6b7, ivory #e3e1d1, antique gold #b3a16f, shadow gold #817454, soft skin #c8ac8d. No airbrushing or gradients. Transparent background, no text, no extra elements.
